scope: Synthetic/offline preparation and CPU regression only; no production corpus, training or GPU run

artifacts.generated_fixture_location: pytest temporary directories only; not committed
artifacts.corpus_format: content-addressed JSON with exact token IDs, document hashes/boundaries, EOS rule and tail
artifacts.initialization_format: per-seed CPU-FP32 safetensors with canonical tensor-content SHA-256 and sealed metadata
artifacts.order_format: seeded epoch permutation, cursor, dedicated RNG state and rolling prefix SHA-256
artifacts.panel_format: sealed nested OWT panels, separate calibration and three-field domain inputs

invariants_verified: NFC, CRLF-to-LF, strip and empty-text rejection
exact normalized SHA-256 dedup and first-64-bit big-endian modulo-1000 document partitions
zero document overlap, pinned source order, exactly one inter-document EOS and only final partial block dropped
manifest and tokenizer mismatch/corruption rejection; synthetic manifest hashes reproduce
identical per-seed initialization tensor hashes across conditions and caller-default-dtype isolation
microbatch-independent ordered 64-block updates with exact epoch/cursor/RNG resume and horizon-independent continuation
8192 input tokens and 8128 shifted targets per effective update
dense64 nested in full300 nested in NLL2000; independent calibration16x64
100 each SST-2 validation sentences, GSM8K test questions and HumanEval test prompts; no answer/completion/test leakage
shared 128/40 domain document prefixes, right-padding masks and insufficient-row failure
